narrative.overview:
The site is read like a book of measured work, not scanned like a SaaS landing page. Each chapter is a full-bleed ground (paper, bone or charcoal) that changes as the reader turns the page; proof is set as typography (names, figures, decisions) rather than packaged into cards, badges or stat bands. Enormous, light Instrument Serif carries titles and names; Hanken Grotesk carries everything read or operated. A fixed charcoal spine on the left holds the menu, the vertical name and a maroon reading-progress line.

Density is low and deliberate: wide gutters, long vertical rests between chapters, content hung on a 12-column grid with a narrow left column for the heading and a wide right column for the matter. Maroon is ink, not paint: it marks the motto, the primary action, links on hover and the active state, and almost nothing else. Motion is a single staggered rise on the cover; the only other moving thing is the chapter II gallery, where vertical scroll drives the case plates sideways. The folio follows the user-pinned reference khanhnguyen.design.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating full-bleed chapter grounds: paper, bone, charcoal.
Display serif at poster scale, set tight (0.86 line height, -0.02em).
Hairline rules as the only structure; no cards, no shadows, no radii.
One accent, maroon, used as ink.
Fixed left spine with vertical name and scroll progress.
One orchestrated entrance (the cover); nothing else animates on entry.

rules.name: The Single Ink Rule
rules.body: Maroon is the only accent. It marks action, state and the motto; it never fills a section, a background panel or a decorative shape.

rules.name: The Two Maroons Rule
rules.body: On charcoal, maroon text is always `maroon-on-charcoal`, never `maroon-ink`. A maroon fill (button) may sit on charcoal because its text is paper.

rules.name: The Tone-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every ground has its own text pair: paper and bone take ink and ink-muted; charcoal takes on-dark and on-dark-muted. Every pair in the build is at least 4.5:1; new pairs must meet the same floor.

rules.name: The Serif Names, Sans Speaks Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif sets titles, names, certification codes and the motto. Anything that is a sentence to read, or a control to operate, is Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a title as a small uppercase tracked label. Context comes from the running head and the left-column structure.

rules.name: The Motto Italic Rule
rules.body: Italic serif is reserved for the motto "Conecta. Desconecta. Reconecta." in maroon. Elsewhere italic appears only as the grotesk's inline emphasis (for example a transparency note).

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Times, years and other aligned figures use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Chapter Ground Rule
rules.body: Every chapter is one full-bleed ground. Grounds alternate so adjacent chapters never share a tone; there are no boxed panels inside a chapter.

rules.name: The Hung Matter Rule
rules.body: Long-form content hangs in the 7-column right block with its head in the 4-column left block; the gap between them is the white space of the page, not a divider.

rules.name: The Flat Folio Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no blur, no glass. If something needs separation, change the ground or draw a 1px rule.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Lists are rows between 1px rules, never cards. A row gets a rule, not a background, a border box or a radius.

dos: **Do** give every chapter a single full-bleed ground (paper, bone or charcoal) and its matching text pair.
**Do** set titles and names in Instrument Serif at 400 with 0.86 line height and -0.02em tracking.
**Do** keep prose in Hanken Grotesk at weight 350, capped at 68ch.
**Do** separate list items with 1px rules and nothing else.
**Do** use maroon-on-charcoal for any maroon text on a dark ground.
**Do** provide the reduced-motion fallback for any scroll-driven or entrance motion, as the cover and gallery do.
donts: **Don't** use cards, boxed panels, shadows or rounded corners.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or fill a section with maroon.
**Don't** put small uppercase eyebrows or kickers above titles.
**Don't** animate content on entry outside the cover's single staggered rise.
**Don't** set body copy or controls in the display serif.
**Don't** reproduce the case thumbnails' deck typography on new surfaces.
